Create procedure CDN.AtrKopiujAtrybuty ( @ZrdTyp smallint, @ZrdFirma int, @ZrdNumer int, @ZrdLp smallint, @ZrdSubLp smallint, @DocTyp smallint, @DocFirma int, @DocNumer int, @DocLp smallint, @DocSubLp smallint, @OpeTyp smallint, @OpeFirma int, @OpeNumer int, @OpeLp smallint, @Blad int OUTPUT
)
AS Begin
insert into CDN.Atrybuty ( Atr_ObiTyp,Atr_ObiFirma,Atr_ObiNumer,Atr_ObiLp,Atr_ObiSubLp, Atr_AtkId,Atr_Wartosc, Atr_AtrTyp,Atr_AtrFirma,Atr_AtrNumer,Atr_AtrLp,Atr_AtrSubLp) select @DocTyp, @DocFirma, @DocNumer, @DocLp, @DocSubLp, aa.Atr_AtkId,aa.Atr_Wartosc, aa.Atr_AtrTyp,aa.Atr_AtrFirma,aa.Atr_AtrNumer,aa.Atr_AtrLp,aa.Atr_AtrSubLp from cdn.atrybuty aa where aa.Atr_ObiTyp = @ZrdTyp and aa.Atr_ObiFirma = @ZrdFirma and aa.Atr_ObiNumer = @ZrdNumer and aa.Atr_ObiLp = @ZrdLp and aa.Atr_ObiSubLp = @ZrdSubLp
set @Blad = @@Error If @Blad<>0 Return
insert into cdn.atrybutyHist ( AtH_Id,AtH_ObiTyp,AtH_ObiFirma,AtH_ObiNumer,AtH_ObiLp,AtH_ObiSubLp, AtH_AtkId,AtH_Wartosc, AtH_AtrTyp,AtH_AtrFirma,AtH_AtrNumer,AtH_AtrLp,AtH_AtrSubLp, AtH_TimeStamp,AtH_OpeTyp, AtH_OpeFirma,AtH_OpeNumer,AtH_OpeLp) select aa.Atr_ID, aa.Atr_OBITyp, aa.Atr_OBIFirma, aa.Atr_OBINumer, aa.Atr_OBILp,aa.Atr_OBISubLp, aa.Atr_AtkId,aa.Atr_Wartosc, aa.Atr_AtrTyp,aa.Atr_AtrFirma,aa.Atr_AtrNumer,aa.Atr_AtrLp,aa.Atr_AtrSubLp, datediff(second,convert(datetime,'1990-01-01',120),convert(datetime,GetDate(),120)), @OpeTyp, @OpeFirma, @OpeNumer, @OpeLp from Cdn.Atrybuty aa join cdn.Atrybutyklasy on aa.Atr_AtkId = AtK_Id where aa.Atr_ObiTyp = @DocTyp and aa.Atr_ObiFirma = @DocFirma and aa.Atr_ObiNumer = @DocNumer and aa.Atr_ObiLp = @DocLp and aa.Atr_ObiSubLp = @DocSubLp and AtK_Historia = 1
set @Blad = @@Error If @Blad<>0 Return
insert into cdn.atrybutyHist ( AtH_Id,AtH_ObiTyp,AtH_ObiFirma,AtH_ObiNumer,AtH_ObiLp,AtH_ObiSubLp, AtH_AtkId,AtH_Wartosc, AtH_AtrTyp,AtH_AtrFirma,AtH_AtrNumer,AtH_AtrLp,AtH_AtrSubLp, AtH_TimeStamp,AtH_OpeTyp, AtH_OpeFirma,AtH_OpeNumer,AtH_OpeLp, AtH_TimeStampDo) Select Atr_ID, @DocTyp, @DocFirma, @DocNumer, @DocLp, @DocSubLp, ah.AtH_AtkId, ah.AtH_Wartosc, ah.AtH_AtrTyp, ah.AtH_AtrFirma, ah.AtH_AtrNumer, ah.AtH_AtrLp, ah.AtH_AtrSubLp, ah.AtH_TimeStamp, ah.AtH_OpeTyp, ah.AtH_OpeFirma, ah.AtH_OpeNumer, ah.AtH_OpeLp, ah.AtH_TimeStampDo from cdn.atrybutyhist ah join cdn.atrybuty on @DocTyp = Atr_ObiTyp and @DocFirma = Atr_ObiFirma and @DocNumer = Atr_ObiNumer and @DocLp = Atr_ObiLp and @DocSubLp = Atr_ObiSubLp and ah.Ath_AtkID = Atr_AtkId join CDN.AtrybutyKlasy on ah.AtH_AtkId = Atk_ID where ah.AtH_ObiTyp = @ZrdTyp and ah.AtH_ObiFirma = @ZrdFirma and ah.AtH_ObiNumer = @ZrdNumer and ah.AtH_ObiLp = @ZrdLp and ah.AtH_ObiSubLp = @ZrdSubLp and (AtK_Okresowe = 1)
set @Blad = @@Error If @Blad<>0 Return
End
